integrity: Complete inductive proof and finite direct-verification program included; no claims of external certification or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only finite rooted ancestor-order frames and the fixed four-world diamond; maps are counted as distinct vertex functions, not modulo automorphisms and without requiring surjectivity. Does not claim the previously known general root-state enumeration of surjective morphisms is new. Literature priority is provisional pending independent scrutiny.
source_ids: Introduction to Modal Logics (draft 2011-09-16; exact public release not established)
title: Sharp extremal bounded-morphism counts from rooted trees to the four-world diamond
